**v0.1.11-nightly.20261120.4969** · 58 changes from 17 contributors

- **Remote port forwarding.** Open remote environment servers in your own browser or local tools from the desktop app.
- **Issues project filter.** Choose any combination of projects to show on the Issues page, and keep your selection after restarting.
- **Side chats in the main thread.** Add a side chat to the main composer or reference it with @, even while the main agent is busy.
- **Fork issues.** View and work with issues from both your fork and its upstream repository.
- **Antigravity Auto mode.** Use Auto to approve edits and safe commands while asking before irreversible actions.
- **Batch environment linking (beta).** Link several environments at once with a single approval.
- **Renewing environment links (beta).** Environment links renew as they are used, so you don't have to pair them again every 30 days.

**v0.1.11-nightly.20261119.4954** · 107 changes from 48 contributors

- **SSH with one-time codes.** Desktop SSH connections can reuse an existing sign-in on hosts requiring a one-time code.
- **Antigravity compaction.** Use /compact in Antigravity sessions that support it.
- **Revert after delegation.** Use Revert files too after subagents finish, even when their chats are retained.
- **Steer Antigravity.** Send steering messages without stopping running subagents.
- **Terminal shortcuts.** Use Ctrl+B in the terminal on Linux and Windows, including as the default tmux prefix.
- **Scheduled task branches.** Tasks created in Settings now run from the project's default branch, even when it isn't main.
- **Offline Connect environments.** Saved T3 Connect environments are preserved when the desktop app starts offline.
